# HARDEGG'S JERUSALEM HOTEL

JAFFA (Palestine)

satfu, Mov. 2.1.1911

Telegr. HOTEL HARDEGG

Mollie dear::

Iread your tave leles

on the boat aud was much dictuaud lolarn what the dveler sact about it. alchi

gall blad der Jam glad those beessel women laök you in handant Shabe now that your conventimes vor, kat

tra aud she oa you are not meet she ticks. Idonot tiet yoee ken pass d

gael stones as Serge did gryou tem not had there ocemences of pain hefn They say most peope hen guel stones. Jou should folnche dveles advice aboutdel.

Be you Kum. A aur convine Arhat

coffee for brakfast nas ba d fe me Shen
